responsibility: Collects the exported interfaces of the GCN backend for use across the machine description, target hooks, and tree/RTL support files. It declares helpers for constant classification, register and mode legality, address formation, operand printing, prologue/epilogue and builtin expansion, OpenACC lowering hooks, DWARF numbering, calling-convention setup, and reduction/vector utilities, and also provides inline mode-category predicates used by generated MD code and backend logic.
